findings.source: Original PULSE cache contains 352 Kharian mauza administrative records and extent hits for Dhama, Kaira, and Mundeer at the WUP point. These are not parcel polygons or parcel IDs. Original PLRA ArcGIS directory lists PULSE_LMKR folder, while probed parcel MapServer paths return 404. No durable parcel sample exists.
